stage: answer to the 17:32 review: the five defects in v11, and the patch split by unit

defects_fixed.1 subscription before the controls exist: Changed was subscribed immediately after constructing the selector, which is before _status exists and before the initial refresh; the handler touches those controls. The subscription now happens after the whole bar (and _status) is built, and the initial context keeps being applied explicitly once the sections are registered
defects_fixed.2 the handler erased the world's own fre: OnCampaignWorldChanged called SetWriteBlock(null) right after StudioWorldSection.ApplyCampaignWorld, and that method is the owner of the freeze: for a world the game does not load it sets the reason, which my line then cleared. The clear is removed, so the world keeps its own gate
defects_fixed.3 a rejection with no consistent default: StudioCampaignSelector.Reject returned after only setting a label when neither the previous context nor the default resolved. It now calls MarkUnresolved, so the host closes the gate and is told
defects_fixed.4 the session gate did not cover every w: the session patch guarded SetField, Set and ApplyFilesAsync only. It now guards Delete, ReplaceDraft, SetOrder, Undo, Redo and the synchronous ApplyFiles too: ten RefuseWrite call sites, so undo and draft adoption cannot write around a frozen world
defects_fixed.5 play and check: the unresolved-world refusal now comes BEFORE SaveAll, so nothing is saved on the way to a launch that will not happen; the start comes from the captured context when the world section has no live start; the scene fallback to Act I is gone; and both Play and Check re-check the world identity after their await, so a build or a report for one campaign can never be shown for another

patch_split.ai13_wiring_v12: carries only StudioRoot.cs, StudioWorldSection.cs and PlayPreparation.cs lines that belong to the campaign/world choice, the freeze gate and the launch. Twenty of the thirty-five hunks of v11 are here; the other fifteen are the units named below.
patch_split.honest_limitation: the split is by hunk, and two hunks MIX units: the hunk at StudioWorldSection -297 also added the AI-18 Audio property and the AI-36 _assets field (both dropped from v12, which also removed an unused-field compile error), and the vegetation-brush method carries the AI-17 scatter refusal inside the same method as the AI-13 write gate, so those five lines stay in v12 and are named here. The candidate patches for the other units are in this directory as split-candidate-*.patch: they are raw material for the owner, not finished per-unit handoffs, because a mixed hunk cannot be applied without the hunk it shares a method with.
